[jaimex2] OK, so looking into it:
Nintendo eShop codes are locked to the Nintendo Account's region, not the console's region or your physical location
Make new Nintendo Account, country = US.
On console > Settings > Users > Add User > link it.
Buy code on Walmart.com (need US billing/card - VPN alone won't cut it).
Redeem at ec.nintendo.com/redeem or in-console eShop, logged into that US profile.
https://www.virtwave.com/blog/how-to-redeem-nintendo-eshop-c…
